passengers.label: Passengers
passengers.note: Children count towards the total — currently: {current}.

luggage.label: Bags
luggage.note: We only show classes that fit both your passengers and your bags — more bags may hide a smaller class.
luggage.followsPassengers: We assumed one bag per passenger until you change it — erring wider is safer: a class that cannot take your bags is never shown to you.
luggage.atCap: That is the most our largest vehicle can take ({max}). For more bags we arrange more than one vehicle — contact us or request a quote.

tripType.label: Trip type
tripType.roundTripNote: The price includes the return leg.
tripType.awaitingSchedule: The price includes the return leg — set the pickup and return times so the prices are recalculated.

schedule.heading: Pickup and return times
schedule.emptyNote: Choose your return time: if it is on the same day the driver waits for you and the waiting is charged at your class's hourly rate; if it is on another day there is no waiting — the round-trip factor alone prices the return.
schedule.otherDayNote: Return on another day — no waiting hours; the round-trip factor alone prices the return leg.
schedule.sameDayNote: Same-day return — {hours} of waiting are charged at your class's hourly rate in the prices below.
schedule.sameDayEstimate: Same-day return — an estimated {hours} of waiting charged at your class's hourly rate. The final figure appears with the prices.
schedule.sameDayZero: Same-day return — the driver's waiting hours are charged at your class's hourly rate.
schedule.orderNote: The return time must be after the pickup time.

services.maxReached: Maximum for this service in one booking: {max}.
services.note: Services are added to your booking total as a separate line after the trip price, and discount codes do not apply to them.

hints.pickOrigin: Pick your pickup point from the suggestions — we need its exact location to measure the distance.
hints.pickDestination: Pick your destination from the suggestions — we need its exact location to measure the distance.
hints.pickPickup: Choose the pickup date and time so we can price the return leg accurately.
hints.pickReturn: Choose the return date and time — or switch to a one-way trip.
hints.returnOrder: The return time must be after the pickup time.

payment.fullNote: Nothing left to pay on the day — your confirmation arrives as soon as we review the transfer.

book.metaDescription: Price your trip by the kilometre in seconds: set your pickup and drop-off points and the number of passengers, and get a clear price for every suitable vehicle class before you book.
book.title: Price your trip and book in a minute
book.lead: Set your pickup and drop-off points and the number of passengers, and we will show the price of every suitable vehicle class right away — with clear details before any commitment.
book.trustTitle: Why the price here is clear

perKm.title: Priced by the kilometre, not by guesswork
perKm.text: The distance is measured along the actual road between your two points, and the price is built directly on it.

autoClass.title: The right class, chosen for you
autoClass.text: We suggest the smallest vehicle that fits your group, and show the next class up if you would like more room.

clearTerms.title: Clear lines, no surprises
clearTerms.text: Every offer shows its breakdown: base fee, distance, waiting time, and the extra services you picked.

instantEdit.title: Adjust your trip in seconds
instantEdit.text: Change the passenger count, the bags, the return time or the trip type, and the price updates instantly.

quoteRequest.metaDescription: Is your trip outside the instant calculator? Request a tailored quote for sightseeing tours, events, daily rentals and large groups — we will reply with a clear offer.
quoteRequest.title: Request a tailored quote
quoteRequest.lead: For tours, events, daily rentals and everything the instant calculator cannot price — send us your trip details and our team will reply with a clear offer.
quoteRequest.calculatorLink: Travelling between two points? Get the price instantly
quoteRequest.useCasesTitle: When should you ask for a tailored quote?

tours.title: Tours with several stops
tours.text: A full-day itinerary with more than one destination — priced as a programme, not as a point-to-point ride.

events.title: Events and celebrations
events.text: Coordinated movements on a tight schedule with several vehicles at once.

daily.title: Daily or multi-day rental
daily.text: A car with a driver at your disposal by the hour or by the day, at a price agreed in advance.

groups.title: Large groups and delegations
groups.text: Numbers beyond a single vehicle — we arrange the right fleet for them.

form.name: Full name
form.detailsPlaceholder: For example: a full-day tour of historic Cairo on the 12th of next month, 6 people, starting from a hotel in Zamalek.
form.detailsHelp: The more detail you give, the faster and more accurate the offer.

errors.detailsTooShort: Describe your request: destination, date and number of people.

done.title: We have received your request
done.text: Our team will review your trip details and get back to you with a tailored quote on the number you gave us.

account.anonymousHint: Have an account with us? Sign in and your trips gather in a single list — and this page stays your way into this booking either way.
account.linkHint: Add this trip to your account and you will find it under "My bookings", with no need for this link.

bookingStatus.metaDescription: Your booking status, transfer details and receipt upload.
bookingStatus.title: Your booking details
bookingStatus.saveLink: Save this link to follow your booking — it is your only key to this page.

cancelled.title: This booking has been cancelled
cancelled.text: If the cancellation was not intended, contact us and we will rearrange your trip.

failed.title: We are sorry — this trip did not take place
failed.text: Your trip did not go as it should have, and this booking is now closed for good: it cannot be resumed or rescheduled. Here is what concerns you — your money first, then your trip if you still need it.
failed.refundTitle: What you paid comes back to you
failed.refundText: We do not charge for a trip that did not happen. Our team is arranging the refund of what you paid and will be in touch about it — for any question, message us quoting your booking number above.
failed.rebookTitle: And if you still need the trip
failed.rebookText: Book it again and you will receive a new booking number. Because we start from scratch, check the time and destination before you confirm — today's price may differ from that of your previous booking.

amounts.heading: Amounts
amounts.remainingNote: The remainder is collected in cash by the driver on the day of the trip.

extras.heading: Add-on services
extras.lead: What you chose with the trip, priced at the moment of booking.
extras.discountNote: The discount applies to the ride price only; add-on services are added afterwards at full price.

rejection.sectionLabel: Why the previous receipt was rejected
rejection.title: Your previous receipt was not accepted
rejection.fallback: Check the transfer details below, then upload the receipt again.

receipts.heading: Transfer receipts
receipts.lead: The receipts we have received for this booking and the status of each.

pay.heading: Transfer {amount} to confirm your booking
pay.holdUntil: Your booking is held for you until {value} — complete the transfer and upload the receipt before then, after which it may be cancelled automatically and its slot released to someone else.
pay.holdPassed: The hold on this booking has expired, and it may be cancelled automatically at any time. If you have already transferred, upload the receipt now; otherwise contact us quoting your booking number.
pay.noAccounts: We will contact you to confirm the payment method — your booking is saved under the number above.
pay.uploadHeading: After the transfer: upload the receipt

review.title: Your receipt is under review
review.text: We have received your transfer receipt and our operations team is reviewing it now. As soon as it is approved, your booking status changes to “Confirmed” on this very page — nothing else is needed from you.

confirmed.title: Your booking is confirmed
confirmed.text: Your transfer has been approved. We will contact you before the pickup time with the vehicle and driver details.
confirmed.completedTitle: Your trip is complete — thank you for trusting us
confirmed.completedText: We look forward to serving you on your next trip.

trip.heading: Trip details
trip.waitingDerivedNote: Calculated automatically from your return time on the same day — the driver waits for you in between.

crew.heading: Your car and driver
crew.lead: This is the car coming for you, and who will be driving it.
crew.phoneWindowClosed: The driver's number is no longer shown now that this trip's pickup time has passed, and it will not appear again. For anything about this trip, contact us directly and quote your booking number.
crew.phoneLaterAt: The driver's number appears on this page shortly before your pickup — at {value}. Nothing is needed from you: open the page then and it will be here.
crew.phoneLater: The driver's number appears on this page shortly before your pickup — open it then and you will find it.

bookingStatus.footerNote: Your booking number is {reference} — quote it in any correspondence about this trip.

track.metaDescription: Closed your booking page? Enter your booking number and the phone number you used, and we will reopen your booking page with its status and transfer details.
track.title: Track your booking
track.lead: Closed the tab or lost the link? Enter your booking number and the phone number you used, and we will reopen your booking page with its status, transfer details and receipt upload.

form.referenceTip: A number starting with TR- shown at the top of your booking page. If you no longer have it, contact us and we will find your booking by your phone number.
form.referenceHelp: Enter it as it is — upper and lower case are treated the same.
form.phoneHelp: The same number you gave when booking — in any format you wrote it.
form.privacyNote: We ask for both numbers to protect your booking: neither one alone opens anything.

errors.invalidInput: Enter both the booking number and the phone number, as you gave them when booking.
errors.notFound: We could not find a booking with these details. Check the booking number and the phone number you used when booking, or contact us and we will find it for you.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts in a short time. Wait a moment and try again, or contact us directly.
errors.dbUnavailable: The search is unavailable right now for a technical reason on our side. Try again shortly, or contact us directly.

help.title: Don't know your booking number?
help.text: Contact us from the phone number you booked with and we will open your booking for you — no need to book again.
help.bookLink: Price your trip and book now

account.metaDescription: All your bookings in one place, and a way to add an earlier booking to your account.
account.title: My bookings
account.lead: Every trip in one place: its status, its time and its amount — and each booking page one click away.

login.metaDescription: Sign in to find your earlier bookings in one place, or create an account in a minute.
login.title: Your account
login.lead: Sign in to find your earlier bookings in one place, and book again without re-entering your details.
login.noAccountNeeded: You do not need an account to track a booking: enter the booking number and your phone on the tracking page.

form.heading: Add another booking
form.lead: Booked before you created your account? Enter the booking number and the phone number you used, and we will add it to your bookings.

form.referenceHelp: Enter it as it is — upper and lower case are treated the same.
form.phoneHelp: The same number you gave when booking — in any format you wrote it.
form.submit: Add this booking to my account

notices.alreadyLinked: This booking is already in your account — you will find it in the list below.
notices.signedOut: You have been signed out. Your bookings are kept exactly as they are, and signing in brings you back to them.
notices.checkEmail: We sent a confirmation message to your email. Open it and click the link to activate your account, and check your spam folder if you cannot find it.
notices.confirmed: Your email is confirmed and your account is active — welcome.
notices.emailConfirmed: Your email is confirmed and your account is active — welcome. Here are your bookings.
notices.confirmFailed: We could not confirm that link. Sign in to request a new message, or contact us.
notices.confirmExpired: That confirmation link has expired or was already used. Sign in to request a new one.

anonymous.title: Sign in to see your bookings
anonymous.text: An account is a convenience, not a gate: you can always book and track without one. With an account your trips gather in a single list, with no link to hunt for.
anonymous.track: Track a booking by its number

env.text: We could not reach your account for a technical reason on our side. Try again shortly, or open your booking by its number from the tracking page.

failed.text: We could not read your list for a technical reason on our side — your bookings are safe as they are. Reload the page shortly, or open your booking by its number.

empty.text: Your account is ready and the list starts with your first booking. If you booked before creating the account, add it with the form below; if you have not booked yet, price your trip in a minute.
empty.book: Price your trip and book it

help.title: Can't find a booking you know you made?
help.text: Bookings are not added to an account automatically — add it with its number and phone, or contact us and we will do it for you.

loyalty.title: Your points
loyalty.unproven: We track your points against your phone number, and you have not verified a number with us yet. Add any past booking using its reference and phone number in the form below — the balance for every trip on that number appears at once.
loyalty.zero: Your balance is zero points right now. Points are earned on completed trips and appear here after your trip runs.
loyalty.spendNote: Your points are applied as a discount when you confirm your next booking — we show you the amount before you confirm.

payment.heading: Pay {amount} to confirm your booking
payment.chooseMethod: Choose whichever suits you best — every method confirms the booking for the same amount.

manual.label: Manual transfer — wallet or InstaPay
manual.hint: You transfer from your own app and upload a photo of the receipt, and our team confirms your booking after reviewing it.

gateway.hint: You are taken to the secure payment page, and your booking is confirmed as soon as the bank's confirmation arrives.
gateway.security: Your card details are entered on the provider's page only — they never pass through our site and are not stored with us.
